solutions.z_error_basis: larger of the inverse-variance fit error and the standard error of the group-to-group scatter, over every consistent narrow emission-line group

line_detection.statistic: continuum-subtracted Gaussian-filtered counts/error with diagonal-noise normalization; not a global false-alarm probability
line_detection.scope: unmasked wavelength coverage near the selected trace; host association not established

spectral.error_scope: fit covariance with unresolved-blend centroid floors; wavelength calibration, background, resampling covariance and line identification systematics are not included

spatial_validation.rule: at least two groups with spatial line SNR >=5 in a 10-pixel interval, containing >=75 percent of strong groups; host association not established

method_parameters.redshift_error: fit covariance with unresolved-blend centroid floors; excludes wavelength and background systematics

spectral.wavelength_warning: sky check passed; full calibration covariance unavailable
spectral.method: Astropy heliocentric optical correction; multiplicative in 1+z

ned.association: nearest catalogue galaxy within 30 arcsec of header pointing; not a confirmed host
ned.coordinate_basis: science header RA/DEC; no slit-to-sky registration
